{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Compute conversion rate for the entire campaign
conversion_rate = sales_completed['converted'].mean()

# Compute average revenue per completed order
avg_revenue_per_order = sales_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = sales_completed['revenue'].sum()

# Break down by channel
channel_summary = sales_completed.groupby('channel').agg(
    orders=('order_id', 'count'),
    total_revenue=('revenue', 'sum'),
    avg_revenue=('revenue', 'mean'),
    conversion_rate=('converted', 'mean')
).round(4)

# Display results
print("Overall conversion rate:", conversion_rate)
print("Average revenue per completed order:", avg_revenue_per_order)
print("Total revenue from completed orders:", total_revenue)
print("\nChannel-wise performance:")
print(channel_summary)"}
